nonPoolDecisions: The 2011 Ordinary scheme prints no listening answer key: only each item’s question tariffs in print order (PDF 10: “Fógra a hAon 4 + 2 + 6 + 2” …) and the one 0–12 language deduction. Every printed question is still carded (every printed ask gets a card): its own criterion at the price its place in that line gives it, its guidance the question as the paper prints it and the item’s tariff line, claimed whole (no partial is printed) and marked tariffOnly. The card says “The scheme prints no answer for this part.”

Card unit, as the reviewed 2012–2026 Ordinary listening: one card per printed item (the Bank plays one recording item as one exercise): three announcements, three conversations (both míreanna on one card) and three pieces, 9 cards; each printed question its own criterion (34).

Each tariff line’s count of addends equals its item’s printed questions and the lines add to the test’s 120, so the n-th addend prices the item’s n-th printed question (grid fields top to bottom, numbered questions in order).

Questions priced at 6 (Fógra a hAon grid field 3, Fógra a Dó 2(a), Comhrá a Dó first mír grid field 4 and second mír question 2) are claimed whole like every other: the scheme prints no split for them.

caveats: Before 2012 the listening test is a paper of its own (Triail Chluastuisceana, 120 marks, Monday 13 June 2011, 4.30–5.10, after Páipéar I), with three items in each part.

Listening tariffs (PDF 10), in print order: Fógra a hAon 4 + 2 + 6 + 2; Fógra a Dó 4 + 2 + 6 + 2; Fógra a Trí 4 + 4 + 2 + 4; Comhrá a hAon 4 + 4 + 4 + 4; Comhrá a Dó 3 + 3 + 3 + 6 + 3 + 6; Comhrá a Trí 4 + 2 + 4 + 2; Píosa a hAon 2 + 4 + 4 + 4; Píosa a Dó 2 + 4; Píosa a Trí 2 + 4 (= 120).
Listening language: “[Gaeilge lochtach : 0 – 12 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh]” (PDF 10) is one test-level deduction; cards state it without applying it.
The scheme prints no listening script and no key for this test.
